name: Omegamon Alter-S
look: a towering white knight trimmed in gold: long legs with golden talons, spiked gold pauldrons, a horned crest with a red visor, a tattered black cape, a long golden sword and a red lion-head shield with a great cannon
entry: A holy knight Digimon in white armour. With the sword on one arm it cuts through anything; with the cannon in the lion's jaws on the other, it fires blasts of absolute cold.
how: Evolves into Omegamon Alter-B at level 70, learning Garuru Cannon.
